lines.text: Owen had a beanie and a neck gaiter.
On the open ridge, the wind found the gaps anyway: his ears, his cheeks, the strip of neck in between.
Ten minutes in, his ears were numb.
Cover up before the wind hits.
A balaclava does it in one piece: hood over the ears, a panel over cheeks and chin, a long neck tucked into your collar.
Save this before your next cold hike.
